newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian Krka to be listed on OTC on Feb 10.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian Krka to be listed on OTC on Feb 10.

text.p: Slovenian drug company Krka will be listed on the over-the-counter (OTC) market of the Ljubljana bourse on February 10, the Ljubljana Stock Exchange said on Friday.
Krka will list 2.9 million shares with a nominal value 4,000 tolars each ($27), representing 83 percent of its equity.
In Slovenia, Krka has a market share of 27 percent, on a par with rival pharmaceutical company Lek.
Krka will join a batch of 27 newly privatised companies that have been listed on the main or OTC market of the Ljubljana bourse since 1996.
At the moment there are 25 shares on the main market and another 29 on the OTC segment of the Ljubljana bourse. -- Marja Novak, Ljubljana Newsroom, 386-61-126-3644
